# laravelforge_region_vpcs (Resource)

Create a private network for the provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelforge_region_vpcs" "example" {
  credential   = 1
  name         = "example-name"
  organization = "my-org"
  region       = "example-region"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential` (Number) The credential ID
- `name` (String) The name of the vpc
- `organization` (String) The organization slug
- `region` (String)

### Optional

- `vpc_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `cidr_block` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `subnets` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import laravelforge_region_vpcs.example my-org/1/example-region/123
```
